adoption_policy.commercial_connector: Reuse the integration owner's pinned design/interface.json and scripts/freecad_geometry.py; never infer a replacement from these references.
adoption_policy.print_compensation: Tune candidate dimensions using coupons, a caliper, the actual filament/nozzle/profile and actual commercial bricks. Never scale the whole STL.
adoption_policy.artwork: New original stepped relief based on the user-supplied character reference. The source photo, people, bag and private file paths are not distributed.
adoption_policy.endorsement: Unofficial personal keepsake; no Nintendo, LEGO or GitHub endorsement and no child-toy certification.
